activities.description: The Presenter introduces the topic (infinite text effects in Photoshop) and explains the first step (finding a texture image).
He demonstrates dragging the texture image into Photoshop and saving it as 'Texture One.'
He shows the process of applying the displacement map effect to text using the saved texture.
He concludes by mentioning the possibility of repeating the process with other textures.

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Let me show you how to make infinite text effects in Photoshop.
Firstly, head over to Google and find a texture with a cool distortion or look.
Then drag that said photo into Photoshop and save the document as something like texture 1.
Now, with your text convert into a smart object, head over to the store,
display, and add 8-8 or whatever different settings for more or less distortion,
choose your texture that you saved and then you're done.
You can literally repeat this with any texture in the world.
